$comment: Machine-readable Sprint 5 plan. Prose rationale lives in specs/sprint-5-charter.md; this file is the shape delivery_loop_gate.py consumes. That script is NOT in this repo — it ships with the pm-skills plugin. Resolve it deterministically: mapfile -t G < <(find ~/.claude/plugins -path '*/pm-skills/scripts/delivery_loop_gate.py' | sort); [ ${#G[@]} -ge 1 ] || { echo 'FAIL: no delivery_loop_gate.py found'; exit 1; }; [ "$(printf "%s\n" "${G[@]}" | xargs sha256sum | awk '{print $1}' | sort -u | wc -l)" = 1 ] || { echo 'FAIL: installs differ -- pin one'; exit 1; }; python3 "${G[0]}" --plan specs/sprint-5-loop-plan.json --mode plan --output human. Sprint goal: board reconciliation + doc consolidation. Done when (A) board triaged, non-Done ≤ deliberate backlog and (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤14 governed docs. No code milestones — housekeeping sprint. WIP cap 3, 2 attempts/task, 6 iterations. Reviewer: claude-review.yml only (no /codex).
goal: Board reconciliation + doc consolidation. Done when: (A) board triaged, non-Done ≤ deliberate backlog; (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤14 governed docs. PLZG Sprint 5.

tasks.title: Fetch and reconcile against origin/dev before any other task runs
tasks.note: Blocking precondition, exempt from the attempt cap. No Jira ticket: it is a precondition the SessionStart hook already runs.

tasks.title: Transition 6 false-WIP items to Done (PLZG-221, -215, -209, -200, -199, -180)

acceptance.cmd: source .env && curl -s -H "Authorization: Basic $ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_BASE64" "https://$ATLASSIAN_URL/rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project%3DPLZG%20AND%20status%3D'Done'%20AND%20key%20in%20(PLZG-221%2CPLZG-215%2CPLZG-209%2CPLZG-200%2CPLZG-199%2CPLZG-180)&fields=key,status" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; expected={"PLZG-221","PLZG-215","PLZG-209","PLZG-200","PLZG-199","PLZG-180"}; seen={i.get("key") for i in json.load(sys.stdin).get("issues", [])}; missing=sorted(expected-seen); assert not missing, f"not Done: {missing}"'

tasks.note: These 6 items are false-WIP: work already merged but tickets still In Progress. Transition each to Done via the Jira API.

tasks.title: Three-bucket triage of To Do backlog (Done/Keep/Won't Do)

acceptance.cmd: source .env && test -f specs/evidence/sprint-5-triage.json && curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Basic $ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_BASE64" "https://$ATLASSIAN_URL/rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project%3DPLZG%20AND%20status%3D'To%20Do'&fields=key,status" | python3 -c 'import json,sys,pathlib; tri=json.loads(pathlib.Path("specs/evidence/sprint-5-triage.json").read_text()); rows=tri.get("items", []); seen={r.get("key") for r in rows}; allowed={"done", "keep", "wont_do"}; assert all(r.get("bucket") in allowed for r in rows), "invalid triage bucket"; assert all(r.get("reviewed_at") for r in rows), "missing reviewed_at"; payload=json.load(sys.stdin); assert isinstance(payload.get("issues"), list), "Jira response missing issues"; todo={i.get("key") for i in payload["issues"]}; missing=sorted(k for k in todo if k not in seen); assert not missing, f"unreviewed To Do items: {missing}"'

tasks.note: Review every remaining To Do item. Bucket as Done (already merged), Keep (real remaining work), or Won't Do (stale/duplicate). Do not bulk-close — review each individually.

tasks.title: Ungovern tier-4 docs + remove additional low-authority docs from governance (28→≤14)

acceptance.cmd: python3 -c 'import re,subprocess; r=subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/validate_specs.py"], capture_output=True, text=True); out=f"{r.stdout}{r.stderr}"; assert r.returncode==0, out; assert "Spec validation passed:" in out, out; m=re.search(r"(\d+) governed", out); assert m and int(m.group(1))<=14, out; print(out.strip())'

tasks.note: Move tier-4 docs (summaries, research) from documents to exempt in doc-registry.json, then ungovern at least these five additional low-authority docs: TASK-TRACKER, BRANCHING-STRATEGY, DEVOPS-SETUP, SPRINT-2-CHARTER, SPRINT-3-CHARTER. Grep D-nnn before ungoverning any doc. Target: ≤14 governed docs.

tasks.title: Cross-check surviving docs for state contradictions

acceptance.cmd: python3 -c 'import json,pathlib; reg=json.loads(pathlib.Path("specs/meta/doc-registry.json").read_text()); manifest=json.loads(pathlib.Path("specs/evidence/sprint-5-doc-crosscheck.json").read_text()); docs={d["doc_id"] for d in reg.get("documents", [])}; reviewed=manifest.get("reviewed_docs", []); covered={d.get("doc_id") for d in reviewed}; missing=sorted(d for d in docs if d not in covered); assert not missing, f"missing review coverage: {missing}"; unresolved=[d.get("doc_id") for d in reviewed if d.get("contradiction")]; assert not unresolved, f"unresolved contradictions: {unresolved}"; assert all(d.get("reviewed_commit") for d in reviewed), "each reviewed doc must record reviewed_commit"'

tasks.note: After T3 reduces the governed set, read each surviving doc and verify its state claims against CLAUDE.md and git log. Record any contradictions found and fix them.

tasks.title: Sprint 5 charter (specs/sprint-5-charter.md), loop plan, Jira sprint creation on PLZG board

acceptance.cmd: python3 scripts/validate_specs.py && test -f specs/sprint-5-charter.md && test -f specs/sprint-5-loop-plan.json

tasks.note: Charter, loop plan, and doc-registry.json update in one PR. Jira sprint metadata is sourced from docs/delivery-coordinates.md (D-026).

tasks.title: Sprint close — both gates green

acceptance.cmd: source .env && python3 -c 'import re,subprocess; r=subprocess.run(["python3","scripts/validate_specs.py"], capture_output=True, text=True); out=f"{r.stdout}{r.stderr}"; assert r.returncode==0, out; assert "Spec validation passed:" in out, out; m=re.search(r"(\d+) governed", out); assert m and int(m.group(1))<=14, out; print(out.strip())' && test -f specs/evidence/sprint-5-triage.json && curl -s -H "Authorization: Basic $ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_BASE64" "https://$ATLASSIAN_URL/rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project%3DPLZG%20AND%20status%3D'Done'%20AND%20key%20in%20(PLZG-221%2CPLZG-215%2CPLZG-209%2CPLZG-200%2CPLZG-199%2CPLZG-180)&fields=key,status" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; expected={"PLZG-221","PLZG-215","PLZG-209","PLZG-200","PLZG-199","PLZG-180"}; seen={i.get("key") for i in json.load(sys.stdin).get("issues", [])}; missing=sorted(expected-seen); assert not missing, f"not Done: {missing}"' && curl -s -H "Authorization: Basic $ATLASSIAN_API_TOKEN_BASE64" "https://$ATLASSIAN_URL/rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project%3DPLZG%20AND%20status%3D'To%20Do'&fields=key,status" | python3 -c 'import json,sys,pathlib; tri=json.loads(pathlib.Path("specs/evidence/sprint-5-triage.json").read_text()); rows=tri.get("items", []); seen={r.get("key") for r in rows}; live={i.get("key") for i in json.load(sys.stdin).get("issues", [])}; missing=sorted(k for k in live if k not in seen); assert not missing, f"unreviewed To Do items: {missing}"; assert tri.get("review_complete") is True, "triage review_complete must be true"'

tasks.note: Procedural close. Both gates must pass: (A) board triaged, (B) validate_specs.py green with ≤14 docs. Update charter status to COMPLETED. Run delivery_loop_gate.py --mode close.
